measurement_definitions.wall_rows_per_s: validated logical rows / seconds from lane start (connector PUT or container start) until all rows are queryable; includes startup
measurement_definitions.insert_window_rows_per_s: validated logical rows / (max(ingested_at) - min(ingested_at)); steady-state insert rate, excludes startup
measurement_definitions.effective_batch_rows: logical rows / number of distinct server insert timestamps (ingested_at); shows the batch size each lane really used
measurement_definitions.latency: live mode only: ingested_at (ClickHouse server clock, Docker VM) - emitted_at (producer send clock, same Docker VM); p50/p95/p99 over all rows of the run
measurement_definitions.resources.lane_a: Kafka Connect container (JVM): cgroup v2 cpu.stat usage delta + peak docker-stats memory; source connectors paused
measurement_definitions.resources.lane_bc: worker process: getrusage CPU (user+sys) and ru_maxrss; container docker-stats peak also recorded
measurement_definitions.phases: lanes B/C only: summed perf_counter_ns per phase from the worker metrics; lane A internals are not observable

not_run.reason: disabled in workload or excluded by --only

known_interference: single Docker VM shared by all services; source connectors paused; one lane at a time
limitations: one local machine (Docker Desktop VM); not production scaling
lane A is a different runtime (JVM connector) and insert format (JSONEachRow): A vs C is a system comparison
B vs C share decode/validate code; differences come from representation, compute and insert format
